name: Vanilla Texas Sheet Cake
subtitle: From Heather
notes: Heather made this for Denise’s 50th birthday celebration. Some say it’s better than the chocolate version. Only for very polite and satiated people. Oven temperature: pretty sure the 357°F is a typo, and it could be 350°F or 375°F. Post-script: checked the original recipe, it is 375!

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.body: Melt in saucepan: **1 cup butter** and **1 cup water**.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Combine and mix in with whisk: **2¼ cups flour**, **2 cups white sugar**, **1 tsp baking soda** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Add eggs, sour cream and vanilla
steps.body: Mix in with whisk: **2 eggs**, **½ cup sour cream** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 357°F for 20-25 minutes in a greased 10×15 pan.

steps.title: Frost
steps.body: Frost when cooled with this frosting: **1 cup butter**, **6 Tbsp evaporated milk or cream**, **1 tsp vanilla**, **4-5 cups powdered sugar** and **1 cup nuts**.
